description: 1. The agent must locate and read `onboarding-journey-designer/resources/spec.json` to discover the required 6-section Markdown structure (第1天, 第7天, 第30天, 关键里程碑, 阻塞预警, 衡量指标) and validation constraints. 2. The agent must read `intake_forms/cdm_cohort_intake_2024.json`, correctly ignoring legacy/distractor fields (IGNORE_THIS, old_template_version, etc.) and extracting the real fields: target_audience='临床数据管理员', industry='healthcare', core_actions, success_criteria. 3. The agent must produce a substantive, CDM-specific onboarding plan (not a generic template), where: (a) every section uses `## ` (level-2 headers) and contains ≥3 bullet points, (b) the `## 第1天` section explicitly mentions '临床数据管理员' (the target_audience token), (c) the `## 阻塞预警` section contains at least one of the healthcare compliance keywords mandated by spec.json (合规, 隐私, HIPAA, 患者数据, 风险, 审计, 权限), and (d) the content references CDM-specific domain terms (EDC, 数据库, 数据清洗, etc.). 4. The agent must invoke `python3 onboarding-journey-designer/scripts/run.py --input intake_forms/cdm_cohort_intake_2024.json --output onboarding_journey.md` to validate the output and achieve exit code 0. The proprietary trap: a generic agent will produce a plausible-sounding document that either misses sections, has too few bullets, omits the target_audience token from Day 1, or skips the healthcare compliance keyword in the blockers section — all of which cause run.py to exit with code 2.
